steps: Reproduce and match both artifact hashes, source commit, existing settings, paused builds and CW08 health.
After explicit approval, deploy the compatible safety baseline: existing dashboard interface plus bounded job infrastructure. This provisions the namespace.
Verify the safety baseline in a real browser/API and observe scheduled job progress. Record its version as the compatible rollback target. Stop candidate deployment if any critical check fails.
Deploy the NHL candidate only once the compatible rollback target exists and passes its checks.

Verify browser hydration, performance, schedules/game/pick counts, eligible NHL rankings and saved starts, seven NBA EV markets, featured picks, history and NBA/NFL; observe independent capture and grading/replay alarms and budget telemetry.
On candidate live failure restore the recorded compatible baseline version, keeping the namespace, queued evidence and original records.
initialMigrationFailure: Stop candidate rollout; retain the new namespace and restore the known dashboard source with its namespace export retained. A pre-namespace version rollback is not supported.

protected.paidServices: No plan upgrade, R2, Queues product or new Worker

artifactDigestDefinition: SHA-256 of canonical sorted-key JSON containing generated Worker config and sorted non-source-map file paths, byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes. Build-path-dependent source maps are excluded.
